scope: Any finite trajectory actually produced by the frozen capped JANUS decision architecture; this theorem does not assert that a forward move always exists.

definitions.S_i: canonical retained decision state after the i-th exact state-changing transition
definitions.reverse_record_i: the exact pre-state plus transition kind and local certificate needed to replay S_i <- S_(i+1) without inverse search

premises_already_proved_or_frozen: Every retained state has state_units<=N^2 by the frozen state cap.
Dense input normalization plus at most 2N extension births keeps every variable identifier O(N), hence O(log N) bits.
Successful v2 births<=n and successful v3 births<=n.
Retained live-variable count never exceeds initial n<=N.
Unit propagation and exact eliminations remove live variables; total state-changing transitions are O(N) under the frozen grammar.

theorem.statement: Store a canonical full pre-state snapshot for every exact state-changing transition together with its transition schema/version and local certificate. Then any reached S_k can be traversed exactly backward to S_0 with no reconstruction search. The total reverse ledger uses O(N^3) internal state units and O(N^3 log N) bits under dense identifiers; reverse replay work is polynomial in N.
proof: Each pre-state snapshot has at most N^2 internal state units.
Therefore all snapshots together use O(N^3) internal units.
Each literal/identifier needs O(log N) bits after the proved dense-ID and <=2N-birth bounds, giving O(N^3 log N) bits.
Backward motion reads the immediately preceding stored canonical state and independently rechecks the recorded local forward certificate; no preimage search or semantic inversion is required.
Thus arbitrary direction switches along an already-created path are polynomial exact operations.

relation_to_BPIRC: This discharges the polynomial reverse-transport/history-size side of BPIRC for every path that the forward theorem machine actually reaches. The remaining P-vs-NP obstacle is forward HIGH_VOLUME_RESCUE_TOTALITY, not backward replay.
implementation_target: Add a theorem-mode reversible trace wrapper that records UNIT/ELIM/V2/V3 pre-state snapshots and runs FORWARD->BACKWARD->FORWARD fingerprint round trips without changing decision authority.
